data.body_html:
New Year’s Eve on the Costa del Sol is a spectacle of light, champagne, and sea breeze. For 2032, skip the crowded beachfront and watch the midnight fireworks from the deck of your own private yacht. Our Marbella yacht charter fleet departs from Puerto Banús, giving you front-row seats to the sky igniting over the Golden Mile. All charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, insurance, Spanish IVA (21%), and a selection of drinks and snacks — no hidden costs, just a perfect send-off to 2033.

Why a Yacht Is the Best Seat for Marbella’s NYE Fireworks

Marbella’s main fireworks display launches at midnight from the promenade near the Golden Mile. From a yacht anchored 200-400 metres offshore, you get an unobstructed 180-degree view — not just of the main show, but also of smaller displays in Puerto Banús, Estepona, and even Gibraltar on a clear night. The average December temperature in Marbella is 16°C (61°F), so bring a light jacket and enjoy the cool sea air without the crush of the crowd.

Our NYE Fleet: From Intimate to Grand

We operate 16+ boats from Puerto Banús, the superyacht hub of Marbella. For NYE, we recommend a minimum 4-hour charter to catch the sunset, cruise the coastline, and anchor for the fireworks. Here are the top picks:

  • Tier A – Best value: Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) or Azimut 39 (12.5m, 11 pax) — from €749/2h or €2,299/8h. Skipper, drinks, snacks, and VAT included.
  • Tier B – Premium with extras: Mangusta 80 (24m, 12 pax) or Mangusta 80 Grey (24m, 12 pax) — from €4,719/4h, includes a free jet ski.
  • Luxury maxi-yachts: Ferretti 94 (29m, 12 pax), Canados 86 (26m, 12 pax), or Maiora 26m (26m, 12 pax) — pricing on request via WhatsApp.
  • Catamaran option: Lagoon 380 (11.6m, 10 pax) — stable, spacious, ideal for families. Pricing on request.

For smaller groups, the Dubhe (8m, 5 pax) or Mariah SX21 (6.4m, 5 pax) offer an intimate experience. All boats depart from Puerto Banús and include a skipper, fuel, and the full drinks package.

What’s Included in Every NYE Charter

Every booking comes with zero surprises. Your charter includes:

  • Licensed, English-speaking skipper
  • Fuel for the entire trip
  • Water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, and cava
  • Light snacks (crisps, olives, nuts, or similar)
  • Insurance and safety equipment
  • Spanish IVA (21%) — no extra tax added later

You’re welcome to bring your own food, decorations, or a cake. Just let us know in advance so we can prepare the boat.

Sample NYE Itinerary: Sunset to Fireworks

A typical NYE charter might look like this:

  • 20:00 — Board your yacht at Puerto Banús. Meet the skipper, enjoy a glass of cava.
  • 20:30 — Cruise east towards Marbella’s old town, passing the Golden Mile and La Concha mountain.
  • 21:30 — Anchor off Cabopino or Cala del Faro for sunset photos.
  • 22:30 — Return towards the main fireworks zone near Marbella Marina.
  • 23:45 — Position for the midnight show. Raise a glass of cava.
  • 00:15 — Cruise back to Puerto Banús, with music and more drinks.

This route is flexible — your skipper can adjust based on wind, waves, and your preferences.

How to Book Your NYE 2032 Yacht Charter

NYE is our busiest night of the year. Slots for the most popular boats (Mangusta 80, Ferretti 94, Astondoa 40) often sell out by mid-December. To secure your preferred vessel and time, contact us via WhatsApp or the enquiry form. A 50% deposit confirms the booking, with the balance due 7 days before departure. For Tier A boats, you can book directly online; for all others, we’ll send a personalised quote within 2 hours.
